limits: Do not merge or present the Cygwin path as proven without native Cygwin execution. Linux real-release gate and native Cygwin proof remain pending. The PR's previously claimed Linux gate remains independent and must be reconciled before conflicting execution.
summary: Pushed an experimental isolated branch; the PR head is not changed. Candidate uses a foreground owned launcher, existing assert readiness, and targeted process-tree cleanup on Cygwin or subprocess termination on Unix. A stopped command that leaves the process alive is reported as a failure. Separate remote branch readback matches the pushed head.
verification: Native Windows process-tree probe passed for a controlled parent and child with an unrelated sentinel surviving. Five separate Python logic probes passed for readiness failure, combined create/stop failure, stop failure alone, stop success with a still-live process, and successful cleanup; these used real disposable native Python processes and simulated Solr commands and HTTP responses. One earlier combined probe timed out; one exact controlled child was identified and stopped. Diff check and Python syntax passed. No actual Solr, Gradle, Docker, native Cygwin, Cygwin /proc PID mapping or real Windows batch launcher ran. Local test code remains scratch only.
